Just look at him, always devoted to his work without a single complaint. You should…
你看看他，什么时候都一声不吭，只是埋头做自己应该做的事情。你要是有他……

“Be more like him”, is what this child most likely wanted to say, but they held their mouth shut.
“有他一半好”，这孩子一定是想这样结尾的，但最后他闭上了嘴。

They then moved to a different topic.
他们换了个话题。

You know what? Don’t model yourself after him. Honestly not a good look, either.
不，也别拿他当榜样。说实话，看着也不太好。

The child silently focused on his own tasks.
那孩子一言不发地专注于自己的工作。

Possessed of a tall physique and cold eyes, the child stays impassive as if he weren’t the subject of the conversation nearby, in spite of the fact that his ears weren’t plugged or impaired.
那个个子很高、眼神冷漠的孩子一脸淡然，仿佛自己不是周遭谈论的对象一般，尽管他的耳朵既没有被堵上，也没有失聪。

…Yo, you should at least say something.
……喂，你好歹说两句。

His lack of a reaction seemed to bother the grousing child. That’s when he, the tall child, finally returned that gaze and started talking.
他的无动于衷似乎很是让这抱怨连篇的孩子困扰。这时他，这个高个子孩子，终于回头盯着他开口了。

I don’t believe a reply was demanded of me.
我不认为自己有义务回复。
